The record lists the pavement and courtyard surface. The utility network is not included.
strings.В исходных историях про люк владелец сет: In the original manhole stories, the network owner is unknown; in the river stories, one photograph establishes neither pollution composition nor the supervision level. Assumptions cannot replace missing facts.
strings.В учебном деле принадлежность именно кол: In this training case, ownership of the manhole itself is confirmed by a current extract from the utility network register. A different organisation maintains the courtyard surface. The reception officer does not determine ownership from the appearance of the cover or impose sanctions. The request was received by an authority that arranges its review within its competence.
strings.Все объекты во дворе обслуживает одна уп: One property management company maintains every asset in the courtyard.
strings.Выберите положение, обосновывающее прове: Select the provision that justifies checking competence and then forwarding the appeal. The general review period alone is not what is needed.
strings.Выбирается подтверждённый сетевой маршру: Choose the confirmed network referral route, not an organization selected merely by location.
strings.Вымышленные служебные материалы симулято: Fictional official materials of the simulator
strings.Выписка из учебного реестра сетей: Extract from the training utility-network register
strings.Да, К-17. Он совпадает с номером в карто: Yes, К-17. It matches the number in the inspection record.
strings.Для решения о прекращении переписки учит: A decision to end correspondence takes account of repeated prior substantive replies, absence of new arguments or circumstances, and statutory conditions. Letter count alone is insufficient.
strings.Договор на уборку двора заменяет реестр: The courtyard cleaning contract replaces the utility-network register.
strings.Договор по двору имеет другой предмет: The courtyard contract covers a different subject
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Есть ли на схеме номер нужного колодца?: Does the diagram show the number of the manhole in question?
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия работника М: A complaint about a service centre employee's decisions and actions goes to that centre's director. Do not confuse a centre employee with the body providing the service.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия самого МФЦ: A complaint about the service centre's own decisions and actions goes to its founding authority or an official authorised by a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Закрыть дело, поскольку номера отличаютс: Close the case because the numbers differ by only one digit.
strings.Игнорировать реестр и направить только о: Ignore the register and refer only to the surface-maintenance contractor
strings.Источник подтверждает именно выбранное д: The source supports the specific action selected.
strings.Какое сопоставление обосновывает техниче: Which comparison supports the technical referral route?
strings.Когда адресат ещё не установлен: When the recipient has not yet been identified
strings.Колодец К-17: обслуживание – условная се: Manhole К-17: maintained by the fictional utility operator Network B. The adjacent К-18 belongs to another network. The extract applies to the date of the incident.
strings.Компетентный адресат будет установлен по: The competent recipient will be identified through verification. For now, calculate the latest date for referring the appeal to the competent body. This is not the deadline for eliminating the danger.
The follow-up clarification has been added to the case file.
strings.Материалы дела · реестр и ответ исполнит: Case materials · register and contractor's reply
strings.Найденная страница заменяет проверку обс: The page found replaces verification of the facts of the case.
strings.Найдите норму и подтвердите её применимо: Find the rule and confirm its applicability to the specific documents in the case.
strings.Найдите положение об обязательном уведом: Find the provision requiring notification of the citizen when a written appeal is referred to the competent body.
strings.Направить только организации, обслуживаю: Send it only to the paving contractor because the manhole is in the courtyard.
strings.Новый документ или снимок сопоставляют с: Compare a new document or photograph with the subject and date of the old reply. The same letter writer does not prove the issues are identical.
strings.Номер К-17 в осмотре совпадает с объекто: The number К-17 in the inspection record matches the asset in the utility register; its network affiliation cannot be inferred from a courtyard paving contract.
strings.Номер части статьи 8, обосновывающей нап: Number of the part of Article 8 that justifies forwarding according to competence
strings.Обращение по 59-ФЗ + оперативная передач: An appeal under 59-FZ plus prompt reporting of danger
strings.Общий срок рассмотрения письменного обра: The general written-appeal consideration period is tied to registration. It is not a universal deadline for construction, repairs or pollution removal.
strings.Объект можно сопоставить по идентификато: The asset can be matched by its identifier.
strings.Объяснить заявителю выбранный маршрут бе: Explain the selected referral route to the applicant without promising others' decisions
strings.Орган обеспечивает объективное, всесторо: The body ensures objective, comprehensive and timely consideration, requests materials where needed and provides a substantive reply. An appeal does not replace a budget decision.
strings.Осмотр от {{observed}}: объект К-17, кры: Inspection dated {{observed}}: site K-17, the cover is beside it and no safe barrier is in place. A location diagram is attached. Training material.
strings.Отменить сообщение об ограждении, не раз: Disregard the report that a barrier was installed, without examining the two documents.
strings.Официальное происхождение позволяет прим: An official origin allows the material to be applied to any issue.
strings.Передать актуальное сообщение ответствен: Relay the current report to the responsible duty officer and according to confirmed ownership
strings.Передать оперативную информацию по подтв: Pass the urgent information through the authorized duty officer to the confirmed network operator; handle the appeal under the procedure applicable to your office.
strings.По карточке осмотра от {{observed}} крыш: According to the inspection record dated {{observed}}, the cover has not been fitted and the walkway is not protected.
strings.Помощник: «По месту расположения можно с: Assistant: “The location alone tells us who owns the utility network.”
strings.Попросить заявителя самостоятельно закры: Ask the applicant to cover the manhole personally
strings.Поручить заявителю установить крышку до: Instruct the applicant to fit the cover before the utility service responds.
strings.После принятия решения заявителю направл: After the decision, a reasoned reply must be sent to the applicant no later than the following day. This is a separate action, not a new full complaint consideration period.
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
strings.Предложена самостоятельная опасная работ: The applicant was asked to carry out dangerous work personally.
strings.Предоставление государственной услуги че: Provision of a public service through a multifunctional centre
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.При переадресации гражданина можно не ув: The citizen need not be notified when the appeal is referred.
strings.При переадресации по компетенции граждан: The citizen is notified when an appeal is referred to the competent body; this does not mean that the problem has already been resolved.
strings.Принадлежность конкретной сети подтвержд: The specific network affiliation is confirmed
strings.Принадлежность конкретной сети проверяют: Responsibility for a particular network is checked against information relating to that asset.
strings.Принятое действие не обеспечивает необхо: The selected action does not ensure the required verification of the result.
strings.Приёмная не выполняет сетевые работы сам: The reception office does not carry out utility network work itself.
strings.Приёмная органа исполнительной власти Мо: Reception office of a Moscow executive authority
strings.Проверить регистрацию и полноту материал: Check registration and completeness of the materials
strings.Проверить результат именно по К-17: Check the result specifically for K-17
strings.Разделить подтверждённое ограждение К-17: Distinguish the confirmed cordoning-off of К-17 from the unconfirmed replacement of its cover; request the outcome for К-17.
strings.Результаты разных действий и объектов пр: The outcomes of different actions and for different assets must be checked separately.
strings.Сетевая организация подтвердила огражден: The utility operator confirmed that К-17 had been cordoned off. Its letter enclosed a report on replacing the cover of К-18.
strings.Сначала установите событие и единицы счё: First identify the starting event and counting units, then find the exact date. The calendar does not choose the applicable law for you.
strings.Совпадение идентификатора объекта связыв: The matching asset identifier links the observation to the register.
strings.Содержание покрытия не подтверждает обсл: Maintenance of the paving does not establish responsibility for the manhole.
strings.Сопоставить идентификатор К-17 в карточк: Compare identifier K-17 in the card and the register
strings.Сопоставьте выбранный маршрут, полномочи: Compare the selected referral route, powers and plan. Independent actions may be performed in different orders.
strings.Соседний колодец К-18 автоматически опре: The adjacent manhole К-18 automatically establishes the owner of К-17.
strings.Сотрудник сказал, что двор относится к у: An employee said the courtyard belonged to the property management company. But the dispatcher sent a diagram showing that this manhole is on a different network. The cover is still lying beside it, and people cannot get past safely.
strings.Сохранён самостоятельный ранее поставлен: This is a retained standalone scenario supplied earlier, not a new variant in this release.
strings.Сравните документы: кто их составил, к к: Compare the documents: who prepared them, and which site and issue they concern. Mark only the materials needed for the selected conclusion.
strings.Уведомление автоматически подтверждает з: The notification automatically confirms that the repair is complete.
strings.Условная управляющая организация обслужи: The fictional property management company maintains the courtyard paving. The listed services do not include underground utilities or manhole К-17.
strings.Уточните обстоятельства, прежде чем поль: Clarify the circumstances before using the solution to a similar case.
strings.Уточнить безопасное временное ограждение: Clarify arrangements for safe temporary barriers with authorised contractors
strings.Учебная модель. Принимаете обращение и г: Training model. You receive the appeal and draft referrals to the competent authority and notices. You may not exercise another authority’s powers.
strings.Часть 3 статьи 8 связывает направление о: Part 3 of Article 8 links forwarding an appeal to competence. Article 12 addresses a different issue: the review period. The network owner cannot be identified from the district's name.
strings.Что именно обслуживает управляющая компа: What exactly does the property management company maintain?
strings.Что сообщается о текущем состоянии?: What is reported about its current condition?
